quote: Upon those highways which have official traffic-control devices permitting angle parking, a person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle other than at the angle to the curb or edge of the highway indicated by such devices.

activation.condition: Highway has an official traffic-control device permitting angle parking and selected space is governed by it.

obligation.description: Person must stop, stand or park vehicle at the angle to curb or highway edge indicated by that device.

timing.description: At the observed stop, stand or park interval.

parameter_refs.name: requested_body_angle_degrees
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: engineering target 45 or 30 degrees, actual angle measured

parameter_refs.name: requested_activity
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: stop, stand or park request; actual class reviewed

parameter_refs.name: indicated_angle_degrees
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: reviewed official device indication, 45-degree diagnostic setup
